say:3:1311212001:0.text: Magister, this door is sealed tight! Chippy tried so hard, but it won't budge at all!
say:3:1311212001:0.source_cn: 主人，不行呀，满满试了好几种方法，可这扇门就像是封死了...
say:3:1311212001:0.male: Magister, this door is sealed tight! Chippy tried so hard, but it won't budge at all!
say:3:1311212001:0.female: Magister, this door is sealed tight! Chippy tried so hard, but it won't budge at all!

say:4:1311212002:0.text: Hey, there's someone here! Is she a maid from the castle? She looks so strange...
say:4:1311212002:0.source_cn: 咦，这里有个人，是城堡里的侍女吗？她的相貌好奇怪……

say:5:1311212003:0.text: She's been affected by magic, just like everything else here.
say:5:1311212003:0.source_cn: 她和周围环境一样，都被魔法扭曲了。

say:6:1311212004:0.text: Perhaps she knows how to open the door. We should ask her.
say:6:1311212004:0.source_cn: 也许这位侍女有开门的方法，我们问问她吧。
